title.narrative: SCORE / 1.1.1 Capacity assessment workshops for each partner

description.narrative: Each Anchor CSO partner will receive funding for a local capacity assessment workshop to identify areas for strengthening and develop a plan for organisational capacity strengthening. This will be used to define the focus areas for ongoing development. Costs are for venue, facilitation, food/drinks and local transport.
